history.summary: Freehold (2011) 1,238 sqft 3BR near Kovan MRT in D19's Serangoon belt, $1.79M / $1,446 psf — below the URA median ($1,493.5) with a strong resale-only 7.1%/yr CAGR. Attractive FH value at a liquid quantum near a mature MRT, with the only caveat being a thin 9-transaction sample.
history.rating_rationale: Listed PSF ($1,446) is ~3% below the URA median ($1,493.5) for a freehold 3BR with a strong 7.1%/yr resale-only appreciation, 670m from Kovan MRT (NE line) in the well-established, owner-occupier-heavy Serangoon Gardens area. $1.79M quantum is in the deep buyer band and the efficient-enough FH 3BR appeals to upgrader families. The main caveat is only 9 URA transactions, so the 7.1% rate is directional rather than firm; even discounted it supports a Buy given the discount-to-median and tenure.
red_flags: Only 9 URA transactions — 7.1% appreciation rate is directional, not firm
1,238 sqft is moderately large for a 3BR
Kovan MRT a 670m walk, mature/lower-growth Serangoon micro-market
catalysts: Kovan MRT (NE line) and stable Serangoon Gardens owner-occupier demand
